title: Create an exact unpromoted Wave 4 Durable Authorized Injection State migration candidate

phases.objective: Create and inspect one exact additive Wave 4 migration candidate copied from the reviewed contract-local Durable Authorized Injection State DDL, while proving that it is not yet promoted or dependency-registered.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The exact Wave 4 candidate, reviewed contract-local DDL, current runtime migration contract, and dependency registry
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A frozen secret-free candidate packet proves exact checksum, two-table statement parity, and Wave 3 dependency while runtime promotion and authorization remain false.
steps: Bind the candidate to the exact Integration source after schema-promotion readiness.
Read and hash the candidate migration file.
Compare its parsed statements exactly with the reviewed contract-local DDL.
Require the state table before the rollback child table.
Bind Wave 4 to exact Wave 3 migration, checksum, statement count, and apply-ledger dependency.
Prove Wave 4 is absent from the governed runtime sequence and dependency registry.
Reject checksum drift, source-parity drift, dependency drift, premature promotion, and premature dependency registration.
assertions: The candidate contains exactly two additive CREATE TABLE statements.
The candidate statements exactly match the reviewed contract-local DDL.
The exact Wave 3 dependency remains present and unchanged.
The candidate is not in governed-migration-dependencies.json.
No capability resolution, authorization, dry-run, Apply, live database access, Provider dispatch, deployment, main merge, or Production mutation occurs.

phases.objective: Promote Wave 4 and register its exact Wave 3 dependency through a separate reviewed PR before any authorization can exist.
Require exact ledger and signed readback identity before restart reconstruction can consume the durable schema.
Observe one separately authorized non-production Wave 4 apply and durable lifecycle canary.
This migration-candidate slice grants no promotion, authorization, Apply, runtime, deployment, main, or Production authority.
